g.title: G
g.text: Proposed Protocol v8-Chain — Operation per Round

g.title: s1
g.text: Epoch exhausted (every alive node already served)?

g.title: r1
g.text: Members whose CH died → re-join nearest alive CH

g.title: s2
g.text: Eligible = alive, not CH in this epoch,

g.title: s4
g.text: CHs advertise → each node joins the nearest CH

g.title: r2
g.text: Each CH picks its next hop: relay via a CH closer to the BS
only if cheaper than sending direct

g.title: r3y
g.text: Hand CH role to strongest member

g.title: upd
g.text: Update energy, FND / HND / LND, PDR

g.title: r5
g.text: CHs (farthest from BS first) aggregate own members + relayed data
and forward one packet to next hop or BS

g.title: r6y
g.text: it takes the dead CH's place in the relay path
